text: City Council on April 17 and 18, 2024, referred Item EX13.2 to the June 18, 2024 meeting of the City-School Boards Advisory Committee for consideration. Summary from the letter (March 22, 2024) from Mayor Olivia Chow on Supporting potential city-building opportunities on Toronto District School Board lands. As stewards of over 5,000 acres of land throughout the city, the Toronto District School Board (TDSB) has unique opportunities to advance city-building initiatives on its lands that are deemed surplus, which could bring significant benefits to students and local communities as the city grows. A recent example is the Davisville Community and Aquatic Centre, a new City-led aquatic and multi-use community centre on the site of the Davisville Junior Public School and Spectrum Alternative School.
